contexts.text: Of those in ignorance of truth it is predicated that they wandered in a solitude of way ().
A wilderness of solitude () = the vastation of the Church.
Solitude is predicated of truth, or falsity.
Desert, and solitude () = defect and ignorance of truth.
They are tolerated in no Society... and so their solitude at last appears to them.
Such are thrust down below the right foot, where they are in solitudes.
He was imbued with a more subtle nature, from solitude.
Those in solitude of life easily fall into such (melancholy and phantasies).
The desert as Eden, and the solitude as the garden of Jehovah () = that they shall have good and truth in abundance. A solitude = where there is no truth. AE 375:33.
A land of solitude and drought () = a state of non-perception of good. AE 730:38.
A solitude and a waste () = devoid of all truth and of all good.
Your land a solitude () = the Church devastated as to all truth.
